physical_explanation: segments.i.young_pa and section dimensions jointly determine EI through the actual section inertia tensor. Shape and section angle affect both bending directions.

Density and physical masses affect inertia; physical_parameters.viscosity_y_nm2_s and viscosity_z_nm2_s affect dissipation and settling. A change in dynamic qualification is not automatically a static stiffness improvement.

parameter_relations.limitations: No current experiment, strict derivative, universal length law or task-performance guarantee.
parameter_relations.discriminating_observations: Compare compiled stiffness, mass and response under each isolated change and their matched joint change. Proportional displacement changes alone do not establish localization.

parameter_relations.physical_relation: Density and geometry jointly determine distributed mass; articulated inertia also depends on the declared pose and unchanged rigid components.
parameter_relations.applicability: Both IDs must exist in the current Parameter Registry; same pose, section, mounting and discretization.
parameter_relations.limitations: Fixed-pose inertia is not an optimized task capability or a static stiffness effect.
parameter_relations.discriminating_observations: Inspect total mass and fixed-pose mass matrix independently of stiffness and control adaptation.

skill-parameter-model@1.summary: Begin with a physical mechanism hypothesis and the observation that would distinguish it from a competitor; retrieve only relevant theory and scoped historical experience.
skill-parameter-model@1.when_to_use: A parameter change needs a checked model meaning.
workflow: Begin with a physical mechanism hypothesis and the observation that would distinguish it from a competitor; retrieve only relevant theory and scoped historical experience.

Resolve exact parameter IDs and Observable IDs from the current candidate registries. Trace each parameter through geometry, constitutive laws, force mapping, state solution and the selected control treatment; explicit inputs may override defaults.
Identify parameters that jointly influence the same observable and confounding effects on other observables. State fixed conditions, reference state and competing coupling predictions.

Check continuity, legal perturbation domains, matched identities and qualified branches. Separate M0 mechanisms, M1 fixed input, M2 consistently reoptimized capability and genuinely implemented M3 closed loop.

If the current parameterization cannot express the hypothesized mechanism, propose an explicit versioned change rather than interpreting ineffective coordinates or silently changing the model. Main selects the next action.
outputs: Main-owned falsifiable mechanism question, registered parameter/observable references, matched conditions and interpretation limits

skill-matched-comparison@1.summary: Identify competing hypotheses, interventions and confounders before choosing a comparison. Match task, model protocol, named initial state, environment, evaluation conditions and control treatment.
workflow: Identify competing hypotheses, interventions and confounders before choosing a comparison. Match task, model protocol, named initial state, environment, evaluation conditions and control treatment.
Choose one common baseline, each parameter changed alone, and the same two changes together. Hold every nonresearch parameter fixed and inspect actual registry values, not coordinate labels alone.

For M2 use the same reoptimization opportunities at every point; inspect optimality and report best-found finite-budget comparisons when optimality is unproved. Never mix fixed-input and reoptimized observations.
Retain qualification failures, active-set changes and missing results. Withhold a complete interaction when any of the four matched results is invalid or missing.
Compare delta1=y10-y00, delta2=y01-y00 and I12=y11-y10-y01+y00 with sources and numerical resolution. These are finite local contrasts, not automatically mixed derivatives or global causal laws.
outputs: Main-owned falsifiable mechanism question, registered parameter/observable references, matched conditions and interpretation limits
